case.offline.trigger: connectivity lost while browsing a case

case.confirmBlocked.trigger: tap on any confirm button while a medicine is Pending (Flag 5)
case.confirmBlocked.slot: line in the action bar, above the confirm button; page scrolls to the first Pending medicine
case.confirmBlocked.next: prescribe or disable the medicines, tap again

case.noMedicines.slot: top of the panel (amber notice; Release case in the bar)

case.noPickup.slot: warning notice inside the pinned bar, directly above the buttons
case.noPickup.next: retry call, mark as unavailable or schedule a callback (buttons and sheet)

case.didntConnect.trigger: call attempted but did not connect
case.didntConnect.slot: warning notice inside the pinned bar, directly above the buttons
case.didntConnect.next: call again or schedule a callback (buttons)

call.notThrough.trigger: request refused or leg-1 network/vendor error
call.notThrough.slot: error notice inside the pinned bar, above the buttons

call.doctorMissed.trigger: leg 1 not answered, busy or rejected
call.doctorMissed.slot: warning notice inside the pinned bar, above the buttons

call.onCall.slot: busy main button label, static phone icon
call.onCall.next: end the call on the phone

call.onCallTransfer.slot: neutral notice inside the pinned bar, above Callback

call.resultWait.clear: result arrives or wait times out

call.endedEarly.trigger: result: total connected talk time on this case still under the gate
call.endedEarly.slot: warning notice inside the pinned bar, above the buttons

call.resultMissing.trigger: no result after the wait and the backend check
call.resultMissing.slot: warning notice inside the pinned bar, above the buttons
call.resultMissing.next: Call again, Callback or Unavailable; a late result updates the screen
call.resultMissing.clear: result arrives, new call or case closed

call.transferMissed.trigger: transfer case: call ended after the gate, not transferred
call.transferMissed.slot: neutral notice inside the pinned bar, above Confirm & forward

call.transferFailed.slot: second line of the amber outcome card "Forwarded to HA"

call.skipHa.trigger: Skip HA confirmed during a transfer call
call.skipHa.slot: neutral notice inside the pinned bar
call.skipHa.next: Confirm unlocks when the call result arrives

call.scriptNeutral.trigger: gate passed, route not known yet
call.scriptNeutral.slot: End-of-call script, fallback B (route not known)

call.checkingHa.trigger: doctor taps Confirm prescription (route decided at the tap)

call.connectingHa.next: wait for the HA to join

call.forwardedTell.trigger: no HA free at the tap; forwarded
call.forwardedTell.slot: End-of-call script after a failed transfer / no HA free

call.stillOnCall.trigger: 3 min after the tap with no call result, repeats every 3 min
call.stillOnCall.slot: neutral notice inside the pinned bar, above two answers
call.stillOnCall.copy: proposed (2026-10-24, state 7 — no call result) — needs Apurva approval

call.submittedTitle.slot: title of the grey closed card (7f)
call.submittedTitle.clear: call record arrives → card becomes "Prescription confirmed"

call.submittedText.trigger: Confirm prescription with no call result (state 7d)
call.submittedText.slot: second line of the grey closed card "Waiting for the call record" (7f)

call.transferMissedDoctor.next: read the script, end the call

call.transferMissedPatient.next: read the script, end the call

offer.enableFailed.slot: notice in the footer, above Try again
offer.enableFailed.clear: leaving the offer, or a successful retry

offer.offline.slot: notice in the footer, after tapping Turn on while offline
offer.offline.next: reconnect, tap Turn on again, or Not now
offer.offline.clear: leaving the offer, or a successful retry
